decision: Accept terminal Engine host CI and exact-source retained artifact evidence for a240 CI partition
limitations: Source hashes are bound to committed bytes; artifact contains no copied source tree, library or executable bytes.
Native VM nine command outcomes/log hashes and binary/tool hashes are receipt claims; their command logs and binary bytes are absent.
TSAN applies to fresh Swift host harness; Rust static archive was not rebuilt or TSAN-instrumented by the binding runner.
No JNI, Looper, native runtime, simulator/emulator/device, literal debugger matrix, public V2, signed UI, immutable package, release or GA qualification.
